citations.claim: NS green at step 69 just before yellow
NS yellow at step 70 lasting only one step
already all-red at first violating step 71, so yellow lasted 1s instead of 3s

counterfactual.change: set actuated false (fixed-time); yellow then lasts full 3s and no violation

explanation: Actuated control ends NS green early once its own queue empties (N queue 1->0 at steps 68-69 with EW demand waiting) and then truncates the following NS yellow to 1s instead of the required 3s, reaching all-red by step 71. Fixed-time with identical timings does not violate, so the actuated gap-out path cuts the yellow timer.
vision_note: The NS signals show green in steps 68-69, turn yellow in step 70, and are already red in step 71 while EW remains red throughout. The yellow phase is thus visible for only one second before the intersection goes all-red.
